pages.text: Total Carnage Manual Amendment Page 1-12, DIP Switch Test This amendment provides additional information to the DIP Switch Test procedure. The number of keys required to enter the Pleasure Dome is DIP switch selectable. See DIP Switch 1 Setting Table below.
